title: rssm-rollout-drift: Quantifying Open-Loop Rollout Error Accumulation in a Recurrent State-Space World Model
description:
A from-scratch PyTorch implementation of a recurrent state-space world model (RSSM, the architecture family behind PlaNet and the Dreamer line) together with a controlled empirical study of how quickly an imagined rollout drifts away from reality on Pendulum-v1.

The repository contains the model, the training code, the data-collection code, the evaluation protocol and the scripts that regenerate every figure in the accompanying technical report.

Scope note: this is a reimplementation and measurement study. It does not propose a new architecture or a new learning algorithm, and it makes no claim of state-of-the-art performance.
notes: Code developed for a reimplementation and benchmarking study; see the repository README for the exact scope and limitations.
